items.title: Repair story creation and multi-worktree metadata authority
items.context: fromDraft currently writes INIT_CHECK metadata without creating or recording a linked worktree; main/worktree metadata drift also lets checklist/review-pass writes land in the wrong copy. Fix bootstrap and mutation authority so active story worktree state is authoritative.
items.userSees: `koala story_create --fromDraft=<draft>` returns a worktree path under `.worktrees/B-xxxx`, and running checklist/review-pass mutations from main for that active story fails with a clear `cd <worktree>` instruction instead of silently writing stale main metadata.

happy.desc: fromDraft story_create creates or reports a linked worktree and records story.worktree metadata

edge.desc: mutable checklist commands for an active story reject main cwd when a linked worktree exists

adversarial.desc: authority detection does not redirect terminal DONE/DISCARDED stories or stories without linked worktrees

verificationEvidence.note: fromDraft CLI smoke creates worktree and records story.worktree metadata
worktree authority smoke rejects main cwd for active linked story mutations
worktree authority smoke confirms terminal DONE stories do not redirect

items.title: Wire cluster commit auto-resolve into promised entrypoints
items.context: syncClusterResolves exists but finding_list and validate do not call it, contradicting CLAUDE.md and leaving Resolves: CL-xxx commits ineffective.
items.userSees: After a commit message contains `Resolves: CL-001`, `koala finding_list --cluster` and `koala validate --story=B-xxxx --json` show the clustered findings resolved with `resolvedBy: CL-001@<sha7>` without manual `finding_resolve`.

happy.desc: finding_list invokes syncClusterResolves before rendering cluster or plain finding views

edge.desc: validate --story invokes syncClusterResolves unless noSync is explicitly requested

adversarial.desc: unknown cluster references remain warnings and do not crash validate or finding_list

verificationEvidence.note: cluster sync smoke proves finding_list applies Resolves CL tags before rendering
cluster sync smoke proves validate story syncs unless noSync is requested
cluster sync smoke exercises warning-safe entrypoints without crashing

items.title: Make review pass persistence and DONE stray cleanup robust
items.context: review_pass_set can report success while writing to the wrong metadata authority; DONE stray cleanup also omits review-passes.json from whitelist, causing untracked main metadata to block merge.
items.userSees: `koala review_pass_set` either records a pass in the active worktree authority and returns the persisted RP id, or errors clearly; DONE cleanup no longer blocks on a stray main-copy `review-passes.json`.

happy.desc: review_pass_set reads back the persisted pass and reports the same id after writing

edge.desc: review-passes.json is treated as safe stray story metadata during DONE merge cleanup

adversarial.desc: review_pass_set detects duplicate or non-persisted RP ids instead of returning success

verificationEvidence.note: review pass smoke proves concurrent review_pass_set writes persist durable passes
stray cleanup smoke proves review-passes json is whitelisted generated metadata
review pass handler now reads back persisted pass and refuses non durable success

items.title: Relax evidence freshness to semantic material changes
items.context: verification evidence should not stale on metadata-only commits and should consistently record materialHash even through checklist_update paths; refresh helpers should stay available for true material changes.
items.userSees: Evidence recorded through both `verification_evidence_add` and `checklist_update --verificationEvidence` contains material freshness data; metadata-only commits remain covered while real material changes still report stale.

happy.desc: new verification evidence written by all supported handlers includes materialHash when git is available

edge.desc: metadata-only commits under story metadata paths do not stale evidence

adversarial.desc: material source/config/test file changes still stale old evidence

verificationEvidence.note: freshness smoke proves direct checklist_update evidence gets headHash and materialHash
freshness smoke proves story metadata changes keep material hash evidence covered
freshness smoke proves material source config and test changes stale old evidence

items.title: Align channel reviewer routing and dispatch evidence with retired LLM channel policy
items.context: CLAUDE.md says koala-review-channel is retired and CLI validate --channel owns the mechanical gate, but REVIEW opt-in still asks for the LLM reviewer; dispatch evidence should also accept direct Agent execution signals when available.
items.userSees: `koala story_advance --phase=REVIEW` lists concept/quality/test-coverage plus relevant docs/behavior reviewers, but no longer asks for `koala-review-channel`; `koala validate --channel` still enforces normal-channel commit/evidence rules.

happy.desc: normal channel reviewer opt-in excludes retired channel LLM reviewer while keeping baseline reviewers

edge.desc: validate --channel accepts direct successful subagent_result evidence as well as dispatch events

adversarial.desc: normal-channel commits by non-implementer without metadata exemption or item evidence still fail channel gate

verificationEvidence.note: flow stability smoke proves retired channel reviewer is absent from opt in gates
flow stability smoke proves direct implementer commit author can satisfy channel evidence fallback
flow stability smoke still rejects main agent real code commits despite koala subject

items.title: Tighten plan freezing and reduce story_review/stale warning noise
items.context: PLAN title/context freeze can be bypassed with remove+add, touchpoint matching treats descriptions as paths, scope_excluded_info is counted as advisory noise, and stale-state warnings repeat after long expected reviewer idles.
items.userSees: `koala story_review` accepts touchpoints like `src/foo.ts (reason)` when `files.modify` contains `src/foo.ts`, reports excluded scope as info instead of an issue, and stale warnings stop repeating after an acknowledged long idle.

happy.desc: touchpoint coverage extracts path prefixes before comparing against checklist files

edge.desc: PLAN remove+add cannot silently bypass title/context freeze without explicit replan/scope audit signal

adversarial.desc: scope_excluded_info and repeated stale idle warnings do not inflate actionable issue counts

verificationEvidence.note: story review ergonomics smoke proves touchpoint path prefixes are normalized
story review ergonomics smoke proves PLAN checklist_add requires explicit audit reason
story review ergonomics smoke proves scope excluded info does not inflate issue count
